newsitem.title: USA: Woodward Governor Co net up in year to Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: Woodward Governor Co net up in year to Sept 30.

text.p: Woodward Governor Co said its earnings for the fiscal year ended September 30, 1996 rose to $22.2 million or $7.67 per share from $11.9 million or $4.11 per share a year ago.
Sales advanced 10 percent to $417.3 million from $379.7 million a year earlier.

The company, which serves the prime mover control and accessory markets, recently said it would seek shareholder approval for a four-for-one stock split. If approved, the company said it would seek a listing on the Nasdaq National Market.
